kind: human-authored source-pinned comparison map, not a computational certificate

status_semantics.qualified: Read the qualification and native domain: a partial or negative theorem is recorded. This never means the full arithmetic ladder level survived.
status_semantics.not_claimed: The whole named level is not established; this does not assert impossibility.
status_semantics.not_applicable: The native object has no corresponding arithmetic input at this level.

arithmetic_firewall: No row constructs a prime-indexed global L-function. Finite graph dynamics, matrix coefficients, virtual representation parents, scalar twist weights, and commutator positivity do not establish arithmetic L4-L9.
default_scope_for_not_claimed: No claim to all parts of this programme level. In particular there is no canonical conductor/gamma/root-number package or arithmetic continuation/functional equation.

objects.domain: Phi:C->C continuous, multiplicative, Phi(1)=1; irrational probe c+exp(ir theta), c>0 and c!=1. Exactly Phi=z^m conjugate(z)^n, m,n>=0.

L0.qualification: The map is globally single valued; m=n=0 is constant one including at zero.

L1.qualification: Scalar multiplicativity is exact and preserves any supplied multiplicative coefficient law. No such arithmetic family is supplied here.

L3.qualification: Every recurrent sequence remains recurrent; the probe order is m+n+1. Generic local order for d distinct noncolliding complex roots is binom(d+m-1,m)binom(d+n-1,n). This is not a uniform bound across unbounded input ranks or transform degrees.

L4.qualification: Only scalar dilation degree m+n and unitary twist weight m-n are proved; determinant, duality and ramified-prime coherence as an arithmetic package are not established.

L8.qualification: Finite state-space/matrix-coefficient recovery is available locally; its output vectors may depend on the matrix. This is not a universal determinant parent or an automorphic/motivic realization.

objects.domain: Phi(re^{it})=r^a exp(ikt), Re(a)>0, k integral, Phi(0)=0; or constant one. Probe c=0.

L0.qualification: These are exactly globally continuous normalized multiplicative maps, with the constant-one exception retaining value one at zero.

L3.qualification: The centered probe always has order one because it sees only exp(ikr theta). This does not imply preservation of arbitrary recurrences; nonpolynomial maps fail every positive nondegenerate probe.

first_exact_obstruction.outcome: fails despite the centered order-one false positive

objects.domain: Probe c=1. Besides constant one, accepted maps have a=N in Z_{>0}, k=N modulo2, without a bound on |k|.

L0.qualification: The map is single valued with its continuous zero extension, even when the formal exponents (N+k)/2 or (N-k)/2 are negative.

L3.qualification: The touching probe has order N+1. At fixed N it accepts infinitely many angular weights. If |k|>N, every positive c!=1 probe is nonrecurrent; this obstruction is proved by residues, not finite samples.

L4.qualification: Only the scalar radial degree N and angular weight k are known. Connected pointwise-continuous families passing this probe are constant; no arbitrary-parameter local-discreteness claim is made.

first_exact_obstruction.outcome: fails away from the touching/centered geometries

objects.domain: F(T)=sum_r product_i Tr(Sym^r A_i) T^r. After deleting rank-one factors, ranks are empty, a single rank, or (2,2).

L0.qualification: The coefficient series and all-matrix representation identities are native and branch independent.

L3.qualification: The local coefficient series is rational. Ranks and construction degrees are fixed; no uniform arithmetic prime family is specified.

L8.qualification: A universal finite graded virtual determinant parent exists in the stated continuous complex representation category. For (2,2), F=(1-det(A)det(B)T^2)/det(1-T A tensor B). The negative relation is virtual, not an effective representation.

objects.L2_boundary: A finite graded determinant factorization is not asserted to be a prime Euler product.

objects.domain: The same all-matrix problem, for every other nontrivial rank profile.

L0.qualification: The original Hadamard coefficient series remains well defined.

L3.qualification: Local rationality survives; failure below concerns a stronger universal representation parent, not rationality itself.

L8.qualification: No universal finite graded virtual determinant parent of the stated kind exists. Identity specialization has a numerator root not a root of unity. A unique formal infinite virtual product remains, but convergence and a natural analytic parent are not established.

first_exact_obstruction.scope: universal finite graded virtual determinant parent only
first_exact_obstruction.outcome: obstructed; does not exclude matrix coefficients or every possible categorical/spectral realization

objects.domain: Finite colored directed graphs, loops and immediate returns allowed, with declared common numerical label spaces; source reversal holds labels fixed.

L0.qualification: Defined once fixed label identifications are part of the source. Reusing numerical labels after discarding/changing those identifications is not a gauge-invariant operation.

L2.qualification: Native directed primitive-cycle Euler products equal inverse transfer determinants. No arithmetic prime Euler product is identified.

L3.qualification: Finite transfer determinants are rational, with degree controlled by declared vertex and label dimensions. These are graph factors, not arithmetic local factors.

L7.qualification: Reversal together with transposed labels preserves the natural determinant duality. This partial operation law is not full arithmetic tensor/induction/twist coherence.

L8.qualification: The independently declared graph has a finite dynamical/transfer realization. Its fixed-label lift response does not descend from the entire commuting multivariable determinant. This is a graph-native statement only.

L9.qualification: The real third-trace gap for W=(UV)* is (3/2)||UV-VU||_F^2 under unitarity. This finite comparison positivity has no RH/GRH or arithmetic explicit-formula consequence.

first_exact_obstruction.scope: recovering the enriched fixed-label response from the scalar shadow
first_exact_obstruction.outcome: no descent; the native graph operator itself still exists

objects.domain: Declared based free group F(a,b), c=(ab)^-1; two word-cycle automata (c,a,b),(c,b,a); one clock step per edge; unitary rho.

L0.qualification: The response is defined on Hom(F,U(d))/U(d). Source, marking and clock are additional data, not reconstructed from an unmarked scalar graph.

L2.qualification: Native twisted primitive-cycle Euler factors and transfer trace laws arise from the same automata; permutation representations give literal finite lifted-cycle products.

L3.qualification: Determinants are (1-t^3)^d and det(1-t^3 K), K=(UV)*(VU). Bound 3d is for fixed representation dimension.

L6.qualification: The finite graph determinant is rational and self-inversive: D(t)=(-t)^(3d) conjugate(D(1/conjugate(t))). This is native unitary reciprocity, with no arithmetic gamma/conductor package or arithmetic functional equation.

L8.qualification: A gauge-covariant finite graph/representation parent is explicit. Both responses agree for every abelianized representation and agree at a given unitary representation exactly when U,V commute. This is not arithmetic L8 survival.

L9.qualification: Native H=(I-K)*(I-K)/2 is positive semidefinite, and unitarity places the finite transfer determinant roots on |t|=1. For permutation sources the principal constant line lies in ker(H), even with positive trace response. Thus there is no principal lower bound, arithmetic positivity, or arithmetic zero-location conclusion.

objects.enrichment_boundary: This repairs a based comparison by adding common holonomy data; it does not invalidate the earlier unmarked/fixed-label operation counterexample.
objects.L6_boundary: The native reciprocal identity and trace-series convergence for |t|<1 do not supply a canonical arithmetic continuation/functional-equation package.
objects.principal_obstruction: For permutation K with r cycles, nullity(H)=r and rank(H)=d-r; the global constant line is always annihilated. A nonzero total commutator defect cannot select or control an arithmetic principal member.

proof_vs_replay: The linked prose proves infinite-parameter statements. Source-authenticated finite replay checks exact controls only; this map does not create any additional proof.
